description:
-= Dish-Pit =-
You've just sauntered into a dish-pit. You begin looking for stuff.

You make out a closed usual looking Canadian style locker close by. You see a fridge. The fridge contains a Canadian style passkey and a mug.

There is an unblocked exit to the north. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.
objective: Welcome to another life changing session of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First thing I need you to do is to retrieve the Canadian style passkey from the fridge in the dish-pit. And then, lock the Canadian style locker with the Canadian style passkey. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
